newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock shares slump, top actives list.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock shares slump, top actives list.

text.p: Shares in Wheelock and Co Ltd slumped in early trade on Wednesday on heavy volume after a placement of 50 million shares was carried out, brokers said.
Wheelock shares fell HK$0.985 to HK$22.90 and topped the actives list with volume of 54.9 million shares. A block of 50 million shares was traded at HK$22.80 at the market opening.

Market sources said that 50 million existing shares were placed late on Tuesday. "I guess it went through earlier on. It is already on the board," said Kent Rossiter, institutional sales manager at Nikko Securities.
Wheelock shares also went ex-dividend on Wednesday.
Wheelock paid a dividend of HK$0.115 for the six months ended September 30.

Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities, said since the placement involved existing shares it should not have an impact on earnings per share. But he said the shares would suffer some short-term selling pressure.
"Usually we do not comment on any shareholder trading of our shares in the market," said Gary Shing, head of Wheelock's corporate affairs office.
